notes: New title screen and main menu with its own music; on phones it asks you to turn the phone sideways before the game
The whole island is open: walk anywhere, climb steep slopes, the Rift and its causeway are reachable (very dangerous early)
New plants made in Blender: lush trees, birches, pines, palms, cacti, bushes, flower patches — no more out-of-place assets
Denser, softer grass that blends with the ground; bigger anime clouds
70 landmarks between towns: camps, old ruins, flower groves, lookout towers and treasure chests with coins
Phones: sharp image with automatic resolution for smooth frame rate, compact HUD, tap the action bubble to interact
Much faster: each person is one draw call (5k triangles instead of 16k), fewer vegetation draw calls
